summary_zh: 泰國EV政策持續牽動製造業：35%EV稅與消費稅局修訂EV皮卡國產零件條件，推動中國EV品牌加速在泰設廠，汽車零件業轉型EV的壓力上升。另有MOU U-TURN配套放寬緬甸與寮國外籍勞工（在泰國工作的外國人）合法引進程序，食品業減碳減塑要求也在提高，值得人資與ESG部門關注。
summary_en: Thailand's 35% EV tax and revised excise rules on EV pickup parts push Chinese EV brands to build local plants, raising pressure on auto-parts makers to shift to EV. MOU U-TURN eases legal entry of Myanmar and Lao foreign workers in Thailand; food makers face tougher carbon and plastic goals.

items.summary_en: LEAPMOTOR Thailand met the BOI secretary-general to discuss plans for a car factory in Thailand.
